units.source:
The first step in any forecasting task is to plot the data. A time plot shows
the observations against time and makes the trend and seasonality easy to see.
units.text: La première étape de toute prévision consiste à représenter les données. Un chronogramme montre les observations en fonction du temps et fait clairement apparaître la tendance et la saisonnalité.

units.source:
library(ggplot2)

# Turn the monthly series into a data frame for plotting
passengers <- data.frame(
  month = seq(as.Date("1949-01-01"), by = "month", length.out = length(AirPassengers)),
  count = as.numeric(AirPassengers)
)

ggplot(passengers, aes(x = month, y = count)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Airline passengers",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Passengers (thousands)"
  )
units.text:
library(ggplot2)

# Transformer la série mensuelle en data frame pour le graphique
passengers <- data.frame(
  month = seq(as.Date("1949-01-01"), by = "month", length.out = length(AirPassengers)),
  count = as.numeric(AirPassengers)
)

ggplot(passengers, aes(x = month, y = count)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Passagers aériens",
    x = "Mois",
    y = "Passagers (milliers)"
  )

units.source:
@fig-passengers shows a clear upward trend. The seasonal pattern also grows
with the level of the series: the summer peaks become larger every year.
units.text: La @fig-passengers montre une nette tendance à la hausse. Le motif saisonnier croît aussi avec le niveau de la série : les pics estivaux s’amplifient chaque année.

units.source:
A seasonal plot draws each year as a separate line, so that the shape of the
seasonal pattern is easier to compare from one year to the next.
units.text: Un graphique saisonnier trace chaque année comme une ligne distincte, ce qui permet de comparer plus facilement la forme du motif saisonnier d’une année à l’autre.

units.source: Each year of the series drawn as its own line.

# One line per year, coloured from earliest to latest
passengers$year <- format(passengers$month, "%Y")
passengers$month_of_year <- as.integer(format(passengers$month, "%m"))

ggplot(passengers, aes(x = month_of_year, y = count, group = year, colour = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  labs(x = "Month of the year", y = "Passengers (thousands)", colour = "Year")
units.text:
# Une ligne par année, colorée de la plus ancienne à la plus récente
passengers$year <- format(passengers$month, "%Y")
passengers$month_of_year <- as.integer(format(passengers$month, "%m"))

ggplot(passengers, aes(x = month_of_year, y = count, group = year, colour = year)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
  labs(x = "Mois de l’année", y = "Passagers (milliers)", colour = "Année")

units.source: July and August are the busiest months in every year of the data.
units.text: Juillet eta août sont les mois les plus chargés de chaque année des données.
